description:
FILED s513a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-08) -- the residue of Text-Balanced t/05_extmul.t once #2860 let it run to its plan (94/2 of 96; perl 96/0): rows 87 and 96.

SILENT WRONG, pre-existing (base 416c710a identical): a `\b` right after `\G`, with pos() > 0, does not see the character BEFORE pos -- it answers as if pos were the start of the string.

    my $t = "my \$p = 1;";
    pos($t) = 1;
    print "G-b: ", ($t =~ /\G\b(y)\b/gc ? "match" : "no"), "\n";
    pos($t) = 1;
    print "G-b-alt: ", ($t =~ m/\G(?:\s*)(\b(?:m|s|y)\b)/gc ? "match" : "no"), "\n";

    perl 5.40.3: no / no        PCL (main 416c710a and s513a): match / match

Through a `\$_[0]` reference and a `(;$)` prototype the same (probe: s513a worktree scratch/s513a/v4.pl).

Real victim: Text::Balanced's extract_quotelike (the `{ DONT_MATCH => \&extract_quotelike }` field of extract_multiple) on "my $p = ...": after 'm' is passed over as unknown text, the quotelike operator alternation `\b(?:m|s|qq|...|y)\b` anchored at \G matches the `y` of `my` as a transliteration operator, so t/05_extmul.t rows 87 and 96 return a different field list (`'m', bless(\'y $p = {y ...', 'DONT_MATCH'), ...`).

Fix site: the regex engine's \b / \B at the match START when the search begins at an offset (the look-behind must read the real previous character, not a string start).  Same question for \B, ^ under /m, and (?<=...) at a \G start -- probe them all.


=== DONE (s523a, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-20) ===
MECHANISM (one): cl-ppcre reads a scan's START argument as the start of the string for `^`, `\A`, `\b`, `\B` and lookbehind unless `cl-ppcre::*real-start-pos*` is bound (vendored copy: closures.lisp word-boundary-p / the start anchors / lookbehind all read `(or *real-start-pos* *start-pos*)`).  PCL's `\G` path already hands the WHOLE string with START = pos (offsets were right: @-/@+/$`/$&/$'/pos all perl's), but nothing bound *real-start-pos* outside s///g's loop (#2981) and the #2723 tail scanner.  So every /g step and every \G anchor from pos > 0 saw a string that began at pos.  WIDER than filed: `$n++ while "aaa" =~ /^a/g` counted 3 (perl 1), `\A` the same, list-context `/^b/g` from pos 1 matched.
FIX: macro `%p-with-real-start` (pos 0 binds nothing; a binding already in force is kept) around the scanner funcall in the TWO scan helpers every do-regex-match path goes through -- `%p-global-scan` (scalar /g, list /g, the \G list emulation, %p-global-scanner's loops) and `%p-ppcre-scan` (the single match with a \G anchor).  cl/pcl-runtime.lisp only; no emission change.
PROBE scratch/s523a/pr/g0.pl (16 lines: \b \B (?<=) (?<!) ^ \A with \G at pos 1; ^/\A/lookbehind in a /g loop; list-context \G\b and ^; offsets after a \G match): perl = tree; base differs on 12 lines.  Fable's c1-g-boundary probe agrees (all seven head assertions inverted on the base, offsets right).
GUARD Pl/t/regex-pos-01.t (13 rows; 12 FAIL on the 8038fac6 extraction, the offsets row passes on both).
ACCEPTANCE: Text-Balanced 05_extmul.t 94/2 -> 96/0 (rows 87 + 96 left baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit).  06/07/09 unchanged by this (228/8, 88/16, 65/16) -- #1568 is a different mechanism.
